capabilities: Create tab controls in notes with an HTML-like tag syntax
Render tab panels containing Markdown, embeds, and code blocks
Customize tab appearance through CSS snippets
disambiguation: Not an HTML editor or renderer; it adds interactive tab controls to notes using an HTML-like tag syntax.
extras: Free with optional donations; documents concrete limitations (task state does not persist across tab switches, and tab content is invisible to queries and the Outline) and lists unimplemented roadmap items.
problem: Obsidian notes are linear documents with no built-in way to group content into switchable tab views within a note.

relations.evidence: Thanks to gapmiss/obsidian-alpinejs which helped me integrating Alpine.js to get the tab switching working.
which helped me integrating Alpine.js to get the tab switching working

summary: Plugin that embeds tab controls and tab panels in notes using an HTML-like syntax, with full Markdown content inside each panel.
